title: merged
description: A pull request for the issue was merged. Written by callum-flow-merge on the device that merged it, by the loop when it finds a merge that no merged event recorded, or by callum-flow-sweep (actor sweep) when it finds a merge on the issue's branch that no event recorded. Ends the claim; the end point of lead time and throughput. Count one per pr and head.

pr.description: The merged pull request; null when the loop found a merge it cannot name.

head.description: The commit that was merged, when known.

by.description: factory: the factory merged it; hand: a person merged it outside the factory.

recovered.description: true when the loop logged it afterwards because no merged event was recorded at the merge.
